en: A black-and-white postcard features a large group of children standing in front of an imposing multi-story brick building with arched windows and a hipped roof. The architectural style suggests a late 19th- or early 20th-century schoolhouse. There are trees in the foreground and hills in the background. The card has the words 'Sundsvall' at the top left and 'Folkskolan.' at the top center.
